# zlaqz1

> Chases a 1-by-1 shift bulge in a complex matrix pencil `(A,B)` down a single position.

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```js
import zlaqz1 from '@rreusser/blahpack/lapack/base/zlaqz1';
```

### Layout API

Takes a storage layout (`order`) and leading dimensions, like CBLAS/LAPACKE.

```js
zlaqz1(
    order,
    ilq, ilz, k, istartm, istopm, ihi,
    A, LDA,
    B, LDB,
    nq,
    qstart,
    Q, LDQ,
    nz,
    zstart,
    Z, LDZ
) → Complex128Array
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `order` | `Layout` | Storage layout (`'row-major'` or `'column-major'`) |
| `ilq` | `boolean` | Whether to update the matrix `Q` |
| `ilz` | `boolean` | Whether to update the matrix `Z` |
| `k` | `integer` | 0-based bulge position |
| `istartm` | `integer` | 0-based start index for column updates |
| `istopm` | `integer` | 0-based end index for column updates |
| `ihi` | `integer` | 0-based upper index of the active submatrix |
| `A` | `Complex128Array`<br><sub>? × N</sub> | **in/out** · Input/output matrix `A` |
| ↳ `LDA` | `PositiveInteger` | Leading dimension of `A` |
| `B` | `Complex128Array`<br><sub>? × N</sub> | **in/out** · Input/output matrix `B` |
| ↳ `LDB` | `PositiveInteger` | Leading dimension of `B` |
| `nq` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Order of the matrix `Q` |
| `qstart` | `integer` | 0-based start index of the matrix `Q` |
| `Q` | `Complex128Array`<br><sub>? × nq</sub> | **in/out** · Input/output matrix `Q` |
| ↳ `LDQ` | `PositiveInteger` | Leading dimension of `Q` |
| `nz` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Order of the matrix `Z` |
| `zstart` | `integer` | 0-based start index of the matrix `Z` |
| `Z` | `Complex128Array`<br><sub>? × nz</sub> | **in/out** · Input/output matrix `Z` |
| ↳ `LDZ` | `PositiveInteger` | Leading dimension of `Z` |

<details>
<summary>Reference notes for each argument (the reference implementation's own documentation; 1-based indices)</summary>

- `ilq`: Determines whether or not to update the matrix Q
- `ilz`: Determines whether or not to update the matrix Z
- `k`: Index indicating the position of the bulge. On entry, the bulge is located in

  ```text
  (A(k+1,k),B(k+1,k)).
  On exit, the bulge is located in
  (A(k+2,k+1),B(k+2,k+1)).
  ```
- `istopm`: Updates to (A,B) are restricted to (istartm:k+2,k:istopm). It is assumed without checking that istartm \<= k+1 and k+2 \<= istopm
- `nq`: The order of the matrix Q
- `qstart`: Start index of the matrix Q. Rotations are applied To columns k+2-qStart:k+3-qStart of Q.
- `nz`: The order of the matrix Z
- `zstart`: Start index of the matrix Z. Rotations are applied To columns k+1-qStart:k+2-qStart of Z.

</details>

**Returns** `Complex128Array`: `Z`

**Throws**

- `TypeError` first argument must be a valid order
- `RangeError` `k` must be a nonnegative integer

### Strided (ndarray) API

Takes explicit strides and offsets for every array. Use it for views, sub-matrices and non-unit strides.

```js
zlaqz1.ndarray(
    ilq, ilz, k, istartm, istopm, ihi,
    A, strideA1, strideA2, offsetA,
    B, strideB1, strideB2, offsetB,
    nq,
    qstart,
    Q, strideQ1, strideQ2, offsetQ,
    nz,
    zstart,
    Z, strideZ1, strideZ2, offsetZ
) → Complex128Array
```

Matrix shapes are logical (rows × columns). The reference's leading dimension (`LDA`, …) is replaced by the two strides and the offset.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ilq` | `boolean` | Whether to update the matrix `Q` |
| `ilz` | `boolean` | Whether to update the matrix `Z` |
| `k` | `integer` | 0-based bulge position |
| `istartm` | `integer` | 0-based start index for column updates |
| `istopm` | `integer` | 0-based end index for column updates |
| `ihi` | `integer` | 0-based upper index of the active submatrix |
| `A` | `Complex128Array`<br><sub>? × N</sub> | **in/out** · Input/output matrix `A` |
| ↳ `strideA1` | `integer` | Stride of the first dimension of `A` (in complex elements) |
| ↳ `strideA2` | `integer` | Stride of the second dimension of `A` (in complex elements) |
| ↳ `offsetA` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Starting index for `A` (in complex elements) |
| `B` | `Complex128Array`<br><sub>? × N</sub> | **in/out** · Input/output matrix `B` |
| ↳ `strideB1` | `integer` | Stride of the first dimension of `B` (in complex elements) |
| ↳ `strideB2` | `integer` | Stride of the second dimension of `B` (in complex elements) |
| ↳ `offsetB` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Starting index for `B` (in complex elements) |
| `nq` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Order of the matrix `Q` |
| `qstart` | `integer` | 0-based start index of the matrix `Q` |
| `Q` | `Complex128Array`<br><sub>? × nq</sub> | **in/out** · Input/output matrix `Q` |
| ↳ `strideQ1` | `integer` | Stride of the first dimension of `Q` (in complex elements) |
| ↳ `strideQ2` | `integer` | Stride of the second dimension of `Q` (in complex elements) |
| ↳ `offsetQ` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Starting index for `Q` (in complex elements) |
| `nz` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Order of the matrix `Z` |
| `zstart` | `integer` | 0-based start index of the matrix `Z` |
| `Z` | `Complex128Array`<br><sub>? × nz</sub> | **in/out** · Input/output matrix `Z` |
| ↳ `strideZ1` | `integer` | Stride of the first dimension of `Z` (in complex elements) |
| ↳ `strideZ2` | `integer` | Stride of the second dimension of `Z` (in complex elements) |
| ↳ `offsetZ` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Starting index for `Z` (in complex elements) |

<details>
<summary>Reference notes for each argument (the reference implementation's own documentation; 1-based indices)</summary>

- `ilq`: Determines whether or not to update the matrix Q
- `ilz`: Determines whether or not to update the matrix Z
- `k`: Index indicating the position of the bulge. On entry, the bulge is located in

  ```text
  (A(k+1,k),B(k+1,k)).
  On exit, the bulge is located in
  (A(k+2,k+1),B(k+2,k+1)).
  ```
- `istopm`: Updates to (A,B) are restricted to (istartm:k+2,k:istopm). It is assumed without checking that istartm \<= k+1 and k+2 \<= istopm
- `nq`: The order of the matrix Q
- `qstart`: Start index of the matrix Q. Rotations are applied To columns k+2-qStart:k+3-qStart of Q.
- `nz`: The order of the matrix Z
- `zstart`: Start index of the matrix Z. Rotations are applied To columns k+1-qStart:k+2-qStart of Z.

</details>

**Returns** `Complex128Array`: `Z`

<section class="examples">

## Examples

```js
import Complex128Array from '@stdlib/array/complex128/lib/index.js';
import reinterpret from '@stdlib/strided/base/reinterpret-complex128/lib/index.js';
import zlaqz1 from '@rreusser/blahpack/lapack/base/zlaqz1';

// Construct a 5x5 complex pencil (A, B) with a small bulge at (2,1).
const N = 5;
const A = new Complex128Array( N * N );
const B = new Complex128Array( N * N );
const Q = new Complex128Array( N * N );
const Z = new Complex128Array( N * N );

let i, j;
for ( j = 0; j < N; j++ ) {
	for ( i = 0; i < N; i++ ) {
		A.set( [ i + ( 2 * j ) + 1, ( i - j ) * 0.3 ], ( j * N ) + i );
		if ( i <= j ) {
			B.set( [ ( i + j + 2 ) * 0.5, ( j - i ) * 0.2 ], ( j * N ) + i );
		}
	}
	Q.set( [ 1.0, 0.0 ], ( j * N ) + j );
	Z.set( [ 1.0, 0.0 ], ( j * N ) + j );
}

// Inject a bulge at (2,1) (0-based):
B.set( [ 0.7, -0.4 ], ( 1 * N ) + 2 );
A.set( [ 1.5, 0.6 ], ( 1 * N ) + 2 );

zlaqz1( 'column-major', true, true, 1, 0, N - 1, N - 1, A, N, B, N, N, 0, Q, N, N, 0, Z, N );

console.log( reinterpret( A, 0 ) );
console.log( reinterpret( B, 0 ) );
```

</section>

<!-- /.examples -->
